newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as Glaxo, BT, utilities gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as Glaxo, BT, utilities gain.

text.p: UK shares closed higher on Thursday as index heavyweights British Telecom and Glaxo gained and hopes grew that Wall Street had seen the worst of its recent correction.
Rising utility stocks also propelled the market higher amid hopes that the "windfall" tax planned by Labour if it wins the May 1 election will be less harsh than previously feared.

"Having opened lower it was a good performance by the market," said the head of trading at one top brokerage. "A large part of it was down to the utilities and on top of that we have not seen any sellers for days."
